title: Not realistic
body: Prices don’t coincide with today’s economic conditions.

title: AI Slop
body: These recipes are not tested by humans. The images are AI. And when you scale the recipe, the instructions do not scale with it, so I had no idea how much water to add to the lentil soup.

title: fees for app use
body: app does not advertise that payment is needed for any action on app and "free trial" still gets charged

title: “Free” Trial…
body: Listen, if you immediately charge me during the “free” trial, it’s not a free trial. That is a paid trial…

title: They lie about the subscription
body: I opened this app on Friday and they said I could do a week trial and they even asked me if I wanted a reminder e-mail a day or two days before the free trial was up. I thought, “how nice to see a company that actually cares.” Well it's Sunday and I just got charged for the year. No reminder and it has not been a week. The recipies did not look appetizing or easy and now I don't trust this company, but I am stuck withan app that cost me forty dollars!

title: Extremely glitchy AI slop
body: The recipes and photography are clearly made with AI and leave out important pieces of information in the instructions. The ingredient pricing does not match actual store pricing. Some weeks the shopping list does not match the chosen recipes and leads you to purchase items you don’t need. It’s also too easy to swap a meal mid-week without being able to recover the meal you chose (and shopped for.) good idea with very poor execution that needs much more work to be worth the pricing, not to mention actual human testing and QA to ensure it’s working as intended.

title: Meh
body: Great idea, app is clunky to use

title: Trial Scam
body: A word of caution to anyone considering to do the free trial. I canceled my subscription before the renewal date. But I was still charged. I’ve also tried to contact them but their website seems to be down. I recommend to keep a close eye on your expiration trial date and saving the confirmation of your cancellation.

title: Inaccurate
body: This app is advertised as a time/money saver, it’s not. It misses the in store pricing by a wide margin, just makes you feel like you’re saving money.

title: don't sign up for membership
body: i've emailed them about this 4 times over the past 3 weeks. i signed up and cancelled my membership all in 10 minutes after realizing the recipes wouldn't work for my autistic kiddo and they still are trying to charge my card for a full year! i had to block apple from being able to pull any money from my account. i reported the app to apple. no response to emails after weeks of issues and no support number to call. such a ridiculous scam of an app and devs

title: No Free Version
body: Forced to do a trial and hand over your CC information so you are sure to forget you signed up. 3 day trial at that. Why not show your value first at least.

title: Free part?
body: Love the concept and it says free unless you choose premium. But once you are in you can’t get beyond the paywall to see if it is worthwhile

title: 17 Pro user big fail
body: Unable To get past first screen. Can’t move keypad to access next step.

title: Scam
body: Signed up for a free trial and canceled five minutes after I signed up and still got charged a monthly fee a few days later. It's a scam.

title: Not free
body: U can not get past the preferences screen without signing up for a “free” trial. Not free at all.

title: App not working
body: Can you pass the ZIP Code?

title: Frozen
body: All I get is the title page. Nothing opens up to use. Great idea but not if it doesn’t work

title: Scam
body: I did the free trial and literally cancelled my subscription 4 minutes later because the app was awful. Still got charged a renewal days later. Don’t download.

title: Grocery list inaccurate
body: I went shopping with the list it gave me & was completely inaccurate.

title: Nonsense app
body: No choice for recipes. No way to adjust quantities for additional portions/servings. Odd choices for food restrictions/dislikes. Pricing is unrealistic and makes no sense at all. (Ex: 3 portions of lemon is 29 cents and salmon is $5.20 at costco! Total for 35 items at costco is $35. There’s no way.)

title: This is nonsense.
body: They say $.20 for 7 oz of arugula from Trader Joe’s. The estimates for pricing they have are so unrealistic that it is painful. Shopped my list that was supposedly $55 from the whole list rang up to $155 in Trader Joe’s. Damn near 3x. Please do not fall for the scam like I did. I checked with the free trial and cancelled immediately.

title: Charged before free trial ended
body: They said they had a 3 day free trial. I was charged a month subscription the next day. I emailed them and they did not respond so I feel like I was scammed.

title: No free version
body: In the description the developers state that there is a free version as well as a premium subscription. What they fail to tell you is that there is no way around the payment screen and you are REQUIRED to go through the trial period which means agreeing to the subscription and being signed up for automatic billing. If you advertise a free version, there should be a way to access such without having to give access to your card/apple/google/android wallet.

title: Doesn’t work
body: It clearly asks “what do you want to avoid”. I put that I didn’t want vegan recipes, fish and tofu. That’s all it gave me.

title: Shopping budget is misleading
body: The shopping budget is misleading because it gives you a cost proportional to the amount used for that recipe. So if you only use 1 tablespoon of salsa, it’s only gonna show the price for that tablespoon of salsa—not the whole jar that you are having to buy. If you only need three scallions, it’ll only show you the price for three individual scallions, not the price to buy the package of eight scallions from which you will have to take the three.

title: Bad Keto options
body: This is great in theory, but I was only given 4 keto meal options on repeat. I tried to remove the keto preference and just go low carb thinking maybe I could get some dishes with rice on the side I could just not eat, but every meal was still pasta, or breadcrumbs, or mashed potatoes. It didn’t feel low carb at all and I just wasn’t thrilled with the lack of variety. I would love this but it’s just not going to work for my dietary restrictions. I also wish there were ways to rank preferences and foods. I don’t mind fish but I really don’t want it often, for example. A pasta dish once in a while would probably be fine but not every week multiple times. Plus, it assumed I had pantry staples that I don’t and I wouldn’t loved to go through a list and uncheck and check things so it could add them to the grocery list. That didn’t appear to work when I tried.

title: Concept good - app needs work
body: Really wanted to love this app. I don’t eat any beans because I can’t and it won’t let me exclude them. They said beans are a pantry staple and included in recipes. Need to change your app to exclude beans. Not everyone wants them or can have them.

title: Selected kitchen equipment does not reflect in recipes
body: I do not have a stove and oven at this time and when I make the equipment selections to reflect that- the recipe output gives me recipes that still require a stove and oven. What’s the point?

title: Cool in theory
body: Cool in theory, but unrealistic in application. You can’t buy partial products at stores. Redo the algorithm to show us how to purchase full products and use them across multiple meals.

title: Not true prices
body: The idea of this app is great but I can’t go to the store and buy $.30 of onions. It’s not how that works. It’s priced for the ingredient amount per the recipe not what you will actually get in the grocery store.

title: Beets?!?!
body: Cool app but I hate beets and it says they are a pantry staple and THEN the first recipe it gave me had BEETS!!! I am offended. I should be able to exclude ingredients I have strong emotions about. Further the food pricing is offensively inaccurate. It has been at least two decades since 2 fillets of salmon were only $5.39 and a medium onion cost $0.38 at Kroger.

title: Need to Add
body: You need to add an air fryer / toaster oven to you kitchen cooking options. I don’t use my oven bc I have a ninja and rarely need the stovetop. Just a suggestion.

title: Cool concept. Could be better
body: Would be great if you could separate meals. You only get option for dinner or lunch and dinner and all for the same days. It would be great if it could help with meal prep such as breakfast/lunch for 5 days and dinner for 3. With whipp you get all or nothing and no breakfast options

title: Great idea …however
body: Fantastic idea poorly executed with sloppy glitchy operation and a juvenile user interface more suitable for a retro easy bake oven Maybe wait for a few more carefully developed version to be offered.

title: Very nice app.
body: App is good i would give it a 5 star and pay double annualy if it had animal based diet options as diet needs.

title: Tasty
body: So far so good

title: Prices need to be updated
body: Great app, very helpful and the recipes are very tasty. Just wished that the pricing could be updated based on where you live because they are very incorrect!

title: Love this budgeting app for my go-to grocery store!
body: This has really helped my husband and I understand how to properly budget for our weeks and months meals.

title: Mom of teens
body: So easy

title: Helpful
body: I always struggle with trying to figure out what to make for my family every night. This takes the guesswork out of it and has stopped my extra spending at the grocery store.

title: Gold Star as a busy mom of 3
body: Has made my life so much easier as a busy Mom of three. I used to dread having to decide what to cook for supper and now I can literally get it done in like five minutes and not have to take time to try and find recipes!

title: Perfect for budget meal planning!
body: As a busy, working, first time mom I was struggling to come up with meal planning each week AND staying in budget. So glad I found Whipp - it’s saved me so much money and time. It had the tastiest recipes too!

title: Title: Such a cool app!
body: Really love the concept behind Whipp! The app is easy to navigate, and I’m excited to keep exploring all its features. Definitely worth checking out!

title: 5 Stars!!!!
body: So glad I came across this app! It helps ssoooo much! I no longer have to struggle to know what to cook. AND!!! I can set my budget for the week for the store I shop at!

title: Love it!
body: Super convenient

title: Life saver !
body: This app has been so great at meal planning, such a relief not to have to plan every meal anymore. It plans everything even makes a tailored grocery list within our budget and with stuff from our preferred stores and with our food preferences in mind ! SO helpful 🙌

title: Makes Meal Planning So Much Easier
body: I’ve been looking for something to make meal planning easier, and this app has been really helpful. I love being able to plan out my meals and have everything organized in one place. Makes grocery shopping and figuring out what to eat for the week so much easier!

title: Busy mom approved
body: As a super busy mom who loves to feed my family healthy but quick meals this app has been everything I was missing. It's so easy to set up, the budget tool is chefs kiss, and being able to either remove and ingredient that I don't like or swap a meal that just doesn't do it for me is amazing !

title: My favorite
body: So easy and user friendly for a busy mom. A really well created app!
